rules.statement: Upon the judgment recovered in an action against a person guilty of a personal tort, it was illegal to seize property vested in other persons who are not parties to the action, simply on the ground that at some previous time the judgment-debtor had been the administratrix of the property which was now vested in the person now claiming.
rules.supporting_quote: Upon the judgment recovered in that action against a person guilty of a personal tort, it was entirely illegal to seize property vested in other persons who are not parties to the action, simply on the ground that at some previous time the judgment-debtor had been the administratrix of the property which was now vested in the person now claiming.
